I can help you sort this out. Unfortunately, I don't have access to your order details or the ability to see what was actually sent, so I can't confirm whether this was a packing error on our side or address the replacement directly.

Please contact our Support Lead with your **order number** (starts with `LF-` plus six digits) and ideally a photo of what arrived. They'll verify what happened and arrange the correct plant for you.

One thing to note: pothos isn't pet-safe, while peperomia is—so if you have pets, it's important to get the right one sorted quickly.
